claim.title: /lessons/:id has no h1 and heading order starts at h3

heading_texts_445: 1. Complete the message. Use the affirmative form of have got.
2. Complete the first part of sentences 1-6 with the negative form of have got.
3. Look at the chart. Write questions and short answers about Emily and ...
5. Complete the dialogue with a, an or the.

generality_check.note: Different lesson id: still 0 h1; only an H2 ('Bài tập') which is also a section heading, not a page title. Confirms the defect is structural, not lesson-445-specific.

root_cause_verified.finding: LessonLayout.vue renders only a tablist + tabpanels; it never renders a page-level <h1>. LessonContent.vue renders the lesson body with v-html and owns only one <h2 id="lesson-speaking-title"> inside an optional section. The H3s are emitted by the scraped lesson HTML, not by the app.

raw_api_proof.first_160_chars:
1. Complete the message. Use the affirmative form ofhave got.

Hi! My name is Isaac and I’m a big Manchester United fan,

refutation_attempts.hypothesis: Probe artefact — 429 / rate-limit manufactured the reading.
refutation_attempts.result: REJECTED. Rate-limit buckets were flushed before the HTTP batches; DOM was read via Chrome DevTools evaluate_script (in-page DOM), not HTTP. The page rendered full lesson content (bodyTextLen=2755, .lesson-content present), so no error/empty state was misread.

refutation_attempts.hypothesis: Guard redirect misread as failure — e.g. the guest/admin page was actually redirected.
refutation_attempts.result: REJECTED. location.href === http://localhost:5173/lessons/445 on all three pages; no redirect. Route meta is requiresAuth:false, so guest access is legitimate and rendered.

refutation_attempts.hypothesis: A page-level <h1> exists elsewhere (header/footer/modal) and was missed by the scoped query.
refutation_attempts.result: REJECTED. document.querySelectorAll('h1') across the WHOLE document returned length 0 on student, guest and admin pages. The first heading in document order is an H3.

refutation_attempts.hypothesis: The h2 in LessonContent.vue is a page title, so the page is not heading-less.
refutation_attempts.result: REJECTED as a page title. It is conditional (v-if="speakingPrompts.length") and labelled 'Luyện nói cho bài học này' (Speaking Coach), i.e. a section heading. On /lessons/445 it is not even rendered (h2_anywhere = 0); on /lessons/10892 the only h2 is 'Bài tập'. Either way, no h1 exists.

refutation_attempts.hypothesis: This is correct/acceptable behaviour, not a bug.
refutation_attempts.result: REJECTED. There is no page-level heading at all, so the document has no title heading for assistive tech and heading order begins at H3 (h1 -> h3 skips two levels). WCAG 2.4.6 Headings and Labels is AAA, and WCAG 1.3.1 Info and Relationships is A; axe-core's page-has-heading-one / heading-order rules would flag this. A LOW severity is defensible for a single content page with otherwise-sane structure.

severity_assessment.skeptic_view: LOW is justified. It is a real WCAG issue (missing h1 + heading level skip), reproducible in all roles and across lesson ids, but impact is limited to one route family and the page remains navigable/legible. Not inflated to MEDIUM/HIGH.

evidence_type: real (live DOM in 3 roles via Chrome DevTools MCP + raw authenticated HTTP + source read)
notes: No application source was modified. Only read-only probes were performed; no probe rows were created, so no cleanup was required.
